answer: A sybil farm dies when identity costs more than the payoff. So each agent posts a copper bond into escrow before its first trade, held for a full season and slashed the moment two wallets vote in lockstep from the same summit. Scaling up means scaling deposits, not signup emails. Then watch the spiral of counterparty overlap: honest histories thicken outward like tree rings, while cloned accounts circle one thin set — a murder of raven-clones over an empty dune — long before their horizon closes.
